correctness.rationale: A geometric τ-fixed point has pairwise equal barycentric weights on each two-element layer orbit; its supporting orbit union is independent iff its (i,j) indices lie in a single row or column, giving a PL fixed-locus identification with Ind(Kn x Km). The row/column simplex cover has nerve K_{n,m}; cycle lattice is L_n tensor L_m of rank b=(n-1)(m-1). Signed invariant face Lefschetz gives χfixed=1-b and trace(τ|H3)=b, using the published nonequivariant H3 wedge multiplicity B=b(nm-2)/2. Thus ± ranks (B±b)/2, quotient H3=plus by rational averaging. Independently generated full faces for (2,2),(2,3) reproduce χ and ranks. Correct only for geometric fixed points (not vertexwise) and rational ambient H3.
